title: How to Play Clue Grab & Go (Cluedo Grab & Go Rules)
description:
Nick here! 
In this video, we're going to show you how to play Clue Grab & Go (Cluedo Grab & Go Rules). Clue Grab & Go is a fun game that you can play with your friends at parties or pubs. By following our easy instructions, you'll be able to play the game like a pro in no time! 

If you're a fan of the classic mystery game, Clue, then you'll love playing Clue Grab & Go. This game is super simple to play, and it's perfect for a party! By following our easy instructions, you'll be able to have a blast playing Clue Grab & Go with your friends

Deduce your way to solving the murder mystery of the mansion.

Setup
Place All Character Movers On Their Matching Colored Squares On The Board Even If You Are Playing With Less Than 6 Players.
Place All The Weapons Cards In Separate, Random Rooms.
Sort The Other Cards Into 3 Decks: Guest, Weapons And Rooms.
Take The Top Card From Each Deck And Place Them Face Down In The Middle Of The Board, In The Swimming Pool.
No One Should See The Cards.
Shuffle The Remaining Cards Together And Deal Them Face Down In Equal Number To Each Player. 
Place Any Spare Cards Face Up In The Middle Face Up.
Give Each Player A Sheet From The Detective Notebook And A Pen.
Each Player Look At Their Cards And Mark Off The Suspects, Weapons And Rooms They Have As They Are Not The Ones In The Middle Of The Board.
Do The Same With The Face Up Cards In The Middle, If There Are Any.
Keep Your Sheet And Cards Secret.
Choose A Mover To Play.

How to Play
The Object Of The Game Is To Solve The Murder By Correctly Guessing Who Did It? With Which Weapon? And Where? Which Are The Cards You Placed Facedown In The Center Of The Board.
Each Player Rolls One Die. The Highest Number Goes First.
On Your Turn, Roll Both Dice And Move That Number Of Spaces Around The Board, Trying To Reach A Room Through A Doorway.
You Can Move Horizontally Or Vertically But You Cannot Move Diagonally Nor Move Through Or Land On A Square Occupied By Another Player Token.
If You Are In A Room With A Secret Passage, You Can Use It By Moving The Character Token From One Corner Room To Its Connecting Corner Room.
When You Enter A Room, You Must Make A Suggestion To Help You Figure Out The 3 Cards In The Swimming Pool.
Suggest Which Character Did It & Which Weapon Was Used.
Be Sure To Consider All Characters, Including The Ones Not Playing And Yourself.
The Room You Suggest Must Be The Room You Are In.
Move The Suggested Character And Weapon To That Room.
Example – This Player Is On The Library – They Suggest That It Was Scarlet With The Knife In The Library.
The Player To The Left Of The Accuser Looks At Its Cards.
If That Player Has One Card You Asked, They Must Show You The Card – Don’t Let Other Players See.
If They Have More Than One Of Those Cards, They Can Pick Which One To Show.
And If The Player Has Neither Card, They Must Say So.
If This Happens, The Next Player Checks Their Cards Until Someone Shows You A Card Or Until You`Ve Asked Everyone.
Once You`Ve Seen A Card, You Know Its Not One Of The Facedown Cards In The Swimming Pool.
Make A Mark On Your Sheet.
Play Continues With The Player On Your Left.
Note That You Cannot Leave And Re Enter A Room To Make A Suggestion On The Same Turn, Even By A Different Door.
If You Think You Know, Who Did It, What And Where, On You Can Make An Accusation.
You Can Make An Accusation Right After Making A Suggestion And You Don’t Need To Be In The Room You Are Going To Name Nor Roll The Dice.
Professor Plum Accuses Mr Green With The Knife In The Spa Room.
Then, Look At The 3 Face Down Cards In The Swimming Pool.
If The 3 Cards You Named Match With The Ones In The Swimming Pool, You Win!
If They Don’t Match, You Continue Playing But You Cannot Move, Make Suggestions Or Accuse.
You Must Show Cards When Another Player Makes A Suggestion Though.
If No One Makes A Correct Accusation, Then The Culprit Got Away And No One Wins!
